heading, What our members say, level 2

We’ve been trying for our 2nd child for 10 months and I was finally diagnosed with polycystic ovary syndrome. I'd been having blood test after blood test, but was yet to receive help until I found your service. The clinician has been amazing, I’m finally getting the help I needed!'
heading, Sarah | Polycystic ovary syndrome & fertility experience, level 5

Between work and two young kids, I was feeling pretty overwhelmed and my mental health was taking a hit. The Vira team pointed me to the therapist services my employer provides and shared some helpful parenting resources. They made everything easier to navigate. It's been really helpful having that support.

This is brilliant 👏 I have had a long journey with perimenopause and menopause. The hormonal replacement therapy journey is different for each woman and with around 52 different symptoms it can be a tough time for women in the workplace. I thank you 💓

After we lost the baby, I didn't know how to support my partner or what to do next. The Vira team was straightforward and genuinely helpful - they answered my questions about our fertility options and gave me practical guidance I could actually use. Really glad I reached out.
heading, James | Pregnancy loss & fertility support, level 5
